title: Supabase vs Firebase for Business Apps
verdict: Choose Supabase for business applications with orders, invoices, stock and reports. Choose Firebase for quick consumer apps with simple data and heavy real-time or offline mobile needs, especially within Google Cloud.
seoTitle: Supabase vs Firebase: Which Backend for Your Business App
seoDescription: Supabase or Firebase for a business app: SQL vs NoSQL data, auth, real-time, pricing model, vendor lock-in and fit for Indian startups and SMEs.
summary: Supabase and Firebase both give an app a ready-made backend: database, authentication, storage and real-time updates. Supabase is built on PostgreSQL, a relational SQL database that suits business data with relationships and reports. Firebase uses Google's NoSQL document databases, which are quick for simple apps and real-time features but harder for complex queries and reporting.

dataPoints.label: Database
dataPoints.value: Supabase: PostgreSQL (relational, SQL). Firebase: Firestore (NoSQL documents)

dataPoints.label: Reporting
dataPoints.value: SQL makes business reporting and joins straightforward in Supabase

dataPoints.label: Lock-in
dataPoints.value: Supabase is open source and Postgres-portable; Firebase ties you more closely to Google

dataPoints.label: Real-time
dataPoints.value: Both offer real-time updates; Firebase has long-established offline mobile sync

dataPoints.label: Auth
dataPoints.value: Both provide email, OTP and social log-in

dataPoints.label: Pricing
dataPoints.value: Both have free tiers and usage-based paid plans; costs depend heavily on usage patterns

body:
## Why this matters for business apps

Business data is relational: customers have orders, orders have items, items have stock. Querying that across a NoSQL store gets awkward and costly as reports grow. See our glossary entry on [databases](/glossary/database).

## Portability

With Supabase you can move to any PostgreSQL host later. Plan exports and ownership either way. See [choosing a tech stack for a business application](/blog/choosing-a-tech-stack-for-a-business-application-in-2026).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.q: Can Supabase keep data in India?
faqs.a: Check the regions available when you create the project and choose the closest suitable one; data residency needs vary by business.

faqs.q: Is Firebase bad for business apps?
faqs.a: No, but SQL databases usually fit business reporting better.
